plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("pricing strategy" OR "price promotion" OR "price discount" OR "promotional pricing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Catches the broad empirical literature on pricing and promotions that a growth marketer repeatedly uses in tests and revenue optimization.

queries.query: ("charm pricing" OR "price endings" OR ".99 pricing" OR "left-digit effect") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Targets evidence on psychological price thresholds and whether non-round prices change purchase likelihood or value perception.

queries.query: ("price discount" OR coupon OR markdown OR rebate) AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Finds work on how different discount formats and incentives affect demand, redemption, and conversion beyond general pricing strategy.

queries.query: ("brand dilution" OR "brand equity" OR "promotion depth" OR "frequent promotions") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Surfaces research on when discounts lift short-term sales but erode quality perceptions, willingness to pay, or long-run brand strength.

queries.query: ("advertising effectiveness" OR "ad effectiveness" OR "creative effectiveness" OR "advertising response") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Covers the main evidence base on which features of ads and messaging predict stronger persuasion, recall, or conversion.

queries.query: ("advertising appeal" OR emotional OR informational OR message framing) AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Targets differences between emotional, informational, and framed messages that matter for response and purchase behavior.

queries.query: ("landing page" OR "website design" OR "conversion rate optimization" OR "online conversion") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Finds studies on page design and digital choice architecture that influence e-commerce conversion rather than broad web usability work.

queries.query: ("scarcity appeal" OR scarcity OR urgency OR "limited time" OR "limited quantity") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Captures evidence on countdowns, low-stock cues, and time-limited offers that can increase action or backfire.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR popularity cue OR "customer reviews" OR testimonials) AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Surfaces research on whether reviews, ratings, and popularity signals shift trust and conversion in shopping contexts.

queries.query: ("choice architecture" OR nudge OR nudging OR default) AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Targets behavioral interventions that alter purchase choices without changing core economics, useful for checkout and funnel design.

queries.query: ("product name" OR naming OR "brand name" OR "brand naming") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Finds work on how names affect memorability, fit, quality inference, and purchase interest for products and offers.

queries.query: ("framing effect" OR "message framing" OR "gain frame" OR "loss frame") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Catches experiments on whether emphasizing gains, losses, savings, or avoidance changes response to offers and campaigns.

queries.query: ("reference price" OR "price anchoring" OR anchoring OR "price comparison") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Targets literature on strike-through prices, comparison points, and internal reference prices that shape perceived deal value.

queries.query: ("checkout friction" OR checkout OR "purchase abandonment" OR "cart abandonment") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Surfaces evidence on what causes shoppers to drop off late in the funnel and which interventions reduce abandonment.

queries.query: ("field experiment" OR "A/B test" OR randomized) AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Adds a recall-safety query tilted toward empirical identification, increasing the share of papers with measurable effects rather than pure theory.

plan.coverage_notes: This plan emphasizes practical levers a DTC growth marketer can act on quickly: pricing, discounting, ad creative, naming, scarcity, social proof, nudges, and checkout conversion. It intentionally skips media history, branding theory without actionable outcomes, and broad strategic management topics. The profile suggests a preference for causal or quasi-causal evidence, so several queries are tuned toward experiments and measurable consumer response rather than abstract frameworks.
